an4.238:1.1: cattārimāni bhikkhave kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditāni. katamāni cattāri? atthi bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ. atthi bhikkhave kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ. atthi bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ. atthi bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati. katamañca bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ?
an4.238:1.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco sabyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti …pe… [vacīsaṅkhāraṃ …pe… manosaṅkhāraṃ …pe…] idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ.
an4.238:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco abyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti …pe… [vacīsaṅkhāraṃ …pe… manosaṅkhāraṃ …pe…] idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kamma sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ.
an4.238:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco sabyāpajjhampi abyāpajjhampi kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti …pe… [vacīsaṅkhāraṃ …pe… manosaṅkhāraṃ …pe…] idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ.
an4.238:4.1: katamañca bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati?
an4.238:4.2: satisambojjhaṅgo, dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo, viriyasambojjhaṅgo, pītisambojjhaṅgo, passaddhisambojjhaṅgo, samādhisambojjhaṅgo, upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo.
an4.238:4.3: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇha asukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
an4.238:4.4: imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditānīti.
